name: branch-namer
description: /branch creates a well-named git branch from a short task description.

prefix.title: Branch prefix
prefix.description: Put in front of every branch, e.g. your initials: ab gives ab/fix/login-bug. Empty = none.

maxSlugLength.title: Max slug length
maxSlugLength.description: Longest kebab-case part of the name, in characters; whole words only.
